before.reproduction: Five replace calls admitted five unresolved fake SHA operations, retaining five snapshots despite a per-input byte cap.

checks: Malformed replacement preserves pending valid generation
Overflow rejects before Proxy getPrototypeOf executes
Latest hash failure frees its slot without restoring old current
Later replacement wins even when an earlier hash completes last
Dispose prevents pending completion from issuing a lease
limitations: No CAD/display conversion, persistence, UI or solver integration
Snapshot count is bounded; hash operation completion is not forced or cancelled
